classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutory necessity finding concerning federal possession of the railroad system; the legally significant determination occurs in this segment, before the subsequent taking.
classifications.evidence: I find that as a result of a labor disturbance there are interruptions, and threatened interruptions

classifications.rationale: This segment inseparably combines the President’s present taking of possession and control, a self-executing legal consequence, with directions and discretionary implementation authority assigned to the Secretary.
classifications.evidence: Possession, control, and operation of the transportation system owned or operated by the Chicago, Rock Island & Pacific Railroad Company (hereinafter referred to as the company) are hereby taken and assumed

classifications.rationale: The President directs federal agencies, the Secretary, and company management concerning cooperation and continued operation of the federally controlled system; these are implementation and internal-management arrangements rather than a new legal-rights disposition.
classifications.evidence: All Federal agencies shall comply with the orders of the Secretary issued pursuant to this order

classifications.rationale: This segment combines discretionary implementation authority for the Secretary, a present conclusive legal designation of federal possession, and a mandated later termination by the Secretary upon his determination.
classifications.evidence: all properties taken under this order shall be conclusively deemed to be within the possession and control of the United States without further act or notice
